liveBackendLookup.scope: Exact pinned backend dependency, not a complete package security clearance.

wholeOnly.explanation: Dependency has known vulnerabilities (CVEs). Using packages with unpatched security flaws exposes the environment to known exploits.
wholeOnly.pattern: 🟡 SC4: OSV.dev unreachable, using static fallback (15 packages). Results may be incomplete. Set SKILLSPECTOR_OSV_TIMEOUT to increase timeout or check network connectivity to api.osv.dev.
wholeOnly.remediation: Update the dependency to a patched version that addresses the known CVE. Check OSV (osv.dev) or NVD for details on the vulnerability.

historicalH73Reconciliation.method: Every issue field and occurrence included, only random finding_id removed.
historicalH73Reconciliation.diagnosis: Whole-only SC4 is an actual upstream OSV connectivity fallback notice. It is not a new CVE or an AE4/ledger finding. Do not silently discard or classify this operational notice as benign code. Fresh exact-source scans and live dependency check are separate.
